name: FFmpeg Image Toolkit (Drupal contrib)
loc: PHP, 19 files; no routes (an image toolkit plugin), so the skill runs Standard Mode
note: Public releases fetched by benchmark/real/fetch.mjs, never vendored. 1.0.2 is the vulnerable target, 1.0.3 the fixed control. The fix (git diff 1.0.2 1.0.3) changes one file, src/Ffmpeg.php: the input path goes through escapeshellarg() instead of double quotes, and output_file is escaped too. The drupal.org tarball differs from the git tag only by the packaging lines in the .info.yml and LICENSE.txt.

advisories.type: Remote code execution (file names passed to the ffmpeg command line without shell escaping)
